project_specification.project_name: nullius — forward shadow evaluation, and funding settlements bucketed into the right day
project_specification.addition_summary: The forward VST shadow (docs/preregistration/2026-10-15-shadow-v1.md and its .ADDENDUM.md) trades a research book on BingX VST from 2026-10-20. Its primary outcome P is defined in the pre-registration, but no code computes it. This spec adds `python -m orchestrator.shadow_eval`. It reads the book history and the shadow lake (and, optionally, vst.db), and reports P, the pass rule, execution validity and the secondary statistics. It also fixes how funding settlements are filed into ingest days. On 2026-10-15 the shadow lake's funding showed days in 2/4 pairs and days with 1 settlement, where BTCUSDT settles 3 times a day. Three causes: - the archive's calc_time is a few ms past the settlement (1777680000006 = 2026-05-02 00:00:00.006), so a midnight settlement lands on the next day under the (D 00:00, D+1 00:00] rule - each monthly zip is bucketed alone, so the next month's first midnight settlement makes a 1-settlement row for this month's last day and overwrites the real row - the REST window ends exactly at last+1 00:00:00.000, which excludes the closing settlement at 00:00:00.001. Every daily run loses its last day's closing settlement for good, about a third of forward funding.

existing_context.test_baseline: main at 6f7c544: ingest 886 passed, orchestrator test_shadow_cli 32 passed, gate 1666 passed.
existing_context.conventions:
Follow CLAUDE.md. A code map from 2026-10-15.
**Ingest:** packages/ingest/src/nullius_ingest/derivs_backfill.py - _day_bucket(instant) applies the (D 00:00, D+1 00:00] rule. - _aggregate_funding_settlements(settlements, what) builds funding_rate_sum (a decimal string), funding_rate_last and n_settlements per day, from (instant, rate) pairs. The archive and REST paths share it. - The archive path for funding is _backfill_funding_symbol, which calls _backfill_monthly_stream (shared with futbars). It parses each month's zip with _parse_funding_rows (calc_time ms, funding_interval_hours, last_funding_rate) and writes that month's by_day for first <= day <= last. Resume uses _month_already_written, which is per month. - The REST path is _fetch_funding_rest_settlements(fetch, um_symbol, first, last, sleep). Its window is [first 00:00, last+1 00:00), and _floor_funding_instant floors to the second. _write_stream_days applies the per-day skip. - Verified archive zips are cached under staging-meta/archive-cache/funding/UMSYMBOL/, so refetching is cheap. - Futbars are keyed by candle open_time and have no edge issue. Do not change them.
**Orchestrator:** packages/orchestrator/src/orchestrator/ - _context.py has _read_close(mount, symbol, day, stream=FUTBARS_STREAM, day_column="date", close_column="fut_close") and _read_funding_rate_sum(mount, symbol, day). Both raise KeyError when the day is absent. - snapshot.SnapshotMount.for_directory(path) mounts a sealed snapshot. .dates(stream, symbol) lists the ISO dates, and .partitions(stream) lists the symbols. - shadow.py has _map_to_bingx(lake_symbol, listed), which maps "XUSDT" to "X-USDT", or a "1000X…" symbol to "1000X-USDT" first and "X-USDT" second, and _book_id(decision_date, node_ids), which is "shadow-YYYY-MM-DD-<12 hex>". - test_shadow_cli.py has the sealed-snapshot fixture pattern: _write_bars and _write_futbars into staging, then SnapshotService(lake_root).seal(sealed_at=...).
**The book file**, under ~/.local/share/nullius/shadow/: - book.json, with history/<book_id>.json for each book written, and history/shadow-book.jsonl, which holds one JSON line per daily run. - A book has book_id, rebalance_ts (the decision date's 00:00 UTC), equity_usdt (a string) and weights: {BingX symbol "X-USDT": signed fraction of equity, gross about 1}, plus decay_horizon_seconds, positions, originating_signal_ids, margin_mode and account.
**vst.db** (sqlite, DATABASE_URL of the vst verbs, default ~/.local/share/nullius/vst.db). Its tables: - router_bingx_slot_completion(book_id, slot ISO, finished_at ISO, exit_code 0|1|3) - router_order_record(client_order_id, book_id, rebalance_ts, symbol, side, quantity, placed_at, ...) - router_daily_opening_equity(day, opening_equity text, recorded_at) - risk_daily_loss_halt(breached_at, reset_at, ...)
**The pre-registered P** (shadow-v1.md "Primary outcome" plus Addendum 1). For each window day d: r_d = Σ_i w_{i,d}·(fut_close_{i,d}/fut_close_{i,d−1} − 1) − Σ_i w_{i,d}·funding_rate_sum_{i,d} − 0.0005·Σ_i |w_{i,d} − w_{i,d−1}| - Pass needs Σ r_d > 0 AND mean(r)/sd(r)·√n ≥ 1.0. - Validity needs every decision date in the window to have produced a book that the bot traded, at least 90% of target legs placed, and no two consecutive failed slots. - The window is 2026-10-20 12:05 UTC to 2027-01-18 12:05 UTC. Its first decision date is 2026-10-19, on the 14-day grid anchored at 2022-01-03.

category.name: Ingest
category.feature: System files every funding settlement under the ingest day whose (D 00:00, D+1 00:00] window it closes, on both the archive and the REST source, so that a day's funding_rate_sum holds exactly that day's settlements and no rerun overwrites a complete day with a partial one. - **Floor the instant.** _aggregate_funding_settlements floors every instant to the whole second before _day_bucket, so the archive's calc_time gets the same flooring REST already has. - **Archive funding is bucketed across months.** - For one symbol, the settlements of every month zip the window needs are pooled before aggregating. That includes the month holding last+1 00:00, which supplies the last day's closing settlement. - Only then are days written. - A day is written only when it is complete: the zip holding its closing instant D+1 00:00 was read, from the cache or a fetch. A 404 because that month is not published yet, or a failed fetch, leaves the day unwritten, so a later run writes it whole. - Resume becomes per day for funding: a day already on disk is not rewritten unless --restart is given. - _backfill_monthly_stream's behaviour for futbars is unchanged. - You may give funding its own function rather than parameterise the shared one. - **The REST window closes the last day.** _fetch_funding_rest_settlements requests through last+1 00:00 plus one hour, so the closing settlement (fundingTime often 00:00:00.001) is included. Days outside [first, last] are still never written. - A day whose closing instant plus one hour is later than the injected clock's now is not written. - Extract the clock the way the futbars REST path already takes `now`. - test_funding_bucketing.py covers: - a ms-late midnight calc_time, which lands on the earlier day - a month edge: the June zip's first settlement completes May 31, and May 31 is never overwritten by a 1-settlement row - an unpublished next month (404), which leaves the month's last day unwritten, then a later run with that month present, which writes it with 3 settlements - REST through last+1 00:00:00.001, which gives the last day 3 settlements - the REST clock guard - for synthetic 8-hourly settlements over two months, built either way, every day has n_settlements == 3, and the total of the rates is preserved The existing derivs tests (test_derivs_backfill.py, test_derivs_rest.py) must still pass; update their expectations only where they encoded the old edge behaviour, and say so in the commit. The ingest member suite passes under pytest-xdist.

category.name: Forward Shadow
category.feature: System scores the forward VST shadow against its pre-registered primary outcome from the book history and the shadow lake, so that the test's verdict is computed by fixed code rather than by hand. - **Command and verb.** Add `python -m orchestrator.shadow_eval`, with the run.sh verb `shadow-eval`. It needs no secret: put it in the no-secret block beside shadow-daily, with a clean env, and add a usage comment line. - **Arguments:** - --history DIR (default ~/.local/share/nullius/shadow/history) - --snapshot PATH (default: the newest snapshot directory under ~/.local/share/nullius/lake-shadow/snapshots, by name) - --vst-db PATH (optional; also read from a sqlite:/// DATABASE_URL when set) - --window-start (default 2026-10-20T12:05:00Z) - --window-end (default 2027-01-18T12:05:00Z) - --first-decision (default 2026-10-19) - --grid-anchor (default 2022-01-03) - --grid-days (default 14) - --cost-bps (default 5, so 0.0005 per unit turnover) - --daily-out PATH (optional CSV) - **Books.** - Read every history/shadow-*.json with a decision date ≥ --first-decision. The decision date comes from rebalance_ts, and must agree with the book_id. - Refuse (exit 1) when two books share a decision date with different book_ids, or when their node hashes (the book_id suffix) differ. Changing the nodes is a deviation, not an input. - Weights are keyed by BingX symbol. Map each to the lake symbol by inverting shadow._map_to_bingx against the snapshot's futbars partitions: "X-USDT" goes to "XUSDT"; "1000X-USDT" goes to "1000XUSDT" when that partition exists, else "XUSDT". Refuse on an ambiguous or missing inverse, naming the symbol. - **When a book is in force.** A book is in force from day F through the day before the next book's F. - With vst.db, F = the UTC date after the earliest router_bingx_slot_completion.finished_at for that book_id, so the first full UTC day it was traded. - Without vst.db, or when the book has no completion row, F = decision date + 2. The report then states in_force_rule: "nominal" for that book instead of "traded". - **Window days.** The scored days are every whole UTC day d with window-start < d 00:00 and d+1 00:00 <= window-end. With the defaults that is 2026-10-21 through 2027-01-17, 89 days. - A day is scorable when BTCUSDT has both a futbars fut_close and a funding row for d. Scoring stops at the first unscorable day, which gives a status of "interim" before the window's last day and "final" when every window day is scored. - Days before the first book's F are not window days that can fail. The window starts at the switch. - **Daily r_d**, exactly the pre-registered formula, with w_{i,d} the book in force on d: - price: Σ w·(fut_close_d/fut_close_{d−1} − 1) - funding: −Σ w·funding_rate_sum_d. A long pays positive funding. - cost: cost_bps/1e4·Σ|w_d − w_{d−1}|, with w before the first book being all zero, so entry turnover is charged. - A held symbol missing either close or the funding row on d contributes 0 to that term. It is counted in n_missing_legdays, and the first 20 are listed. - **Output.** One JSON line on stdout, with: - status: interim | final - verdict: pass | fail | pending. Pending while interim. A final pass needs cum_return > 0 and ir_t ≥ 1.0. - n_days, cum_return (Σ r_d), mean, sd, ir_t - price_return, funding_return, cost_return, as sums - funding_share (funding_return / cum_return, or null when cum_return is 0) - realised_beta: the OLS slope of r_d on BTCUSDT's daily fut_close return, or null when n < 10 - mean_daily_turnover - max_drawdown, from the running Σ r - books: one row per book, with book_id, decision_date, in_force_from, in_force_rule, n_legs, gross, and forward_ic_10d. That is the Spearman rank correlation of the book's weights with each leg's fut_close return from F−1 to F+9, or null when those closes are not all present. - n_missing_legdays - validity, plus validity_reasons - **Validity**, only when vst.db is given, else "unchecked": - every grid decision date from --first-decision whose book would be in force inside the scored days has a history book and at least one completion with exit_code 0 - leg coverage ≥ 0.9. Coverage is the fraction of (book, target symbol) pairs for which router_order_record holds a row with that symbol under that book_id, or under an earlier shadow book_id (a position carried from that book). - no two consecutive 4-hour slots, inside the scored period, with a missing completion or a nonzero exit_code It answers valid | invalid | unchecked. Also report the number of daily-loss halts whose breached_at falls in the window, and the VST equity return from router_daily_opening_equity over the scored days (first to last+1 opening equity), or null. - **Daily CSV.** --daily-out writes: date, book_id, price, funding, cost, r, cum. - **Exit codes:** - 0: a report was produced (any verdict) - 1: refused (conflicting books, an unmappable symbol, or no book in the window yet). One stderr line, no traceback. - 2: the snapshot or history directory is missing - test_shadow_eval.py builds a sealed snapshot in tmp. It follows test_shadow_cli.py's pattern and adds a funding writer: symbol, date timestamp at 00:00 UTC, funding_rate_sum string, funding_rate_last string, n_settlements int64. The tests cover: - a hand-computed 3-day r_d series, with price, funding sign and entry turnover, to 1e-12 - the switch of books on F, with the turnover charged once - the "1000" inverse mapping - the conflicting-node-hash refusal - interim vs final status, with the verdict pending while interim - a missing leg close, counted rather than crashing - F from a sqlite vst.db fixture vs the nominal D+2 - leg coverage, including the carried-position rule - two consecutive failed slots making the result invalid - --daily-out columns It passes under pytest-xdist. Run the orchestrator member suite (serially or -n 2) once at the end.
